study: Phase 2C.1 frozen demand-only history and feature study
reserved_test: 2023-01-01 through 2023-03-31; not scored in this study
selection: All GSPs with >=95% observed coverage in the initial training year; constants retained
evaluation_schedule: Every 13 elapsed days, 29 origins across all seasons and all weekdays
training_schedule: Every 8 elapsed days; cycles weekdays; entire expanding history; declared for memory/runtime
controlled_settings: Existing unweighted L2 LightGBM: 200 trees, 31 leaves, learning_rate=0.05, seed=7, four CPU threads
scope: Validation, per-GSP benefit distribution, volume/daytype/season/lead slices, importance and four feature ablations; no tuning, weather, actual holiday calendar, new algorithms or final test scores
